history.content: {"messages":[{"speaker":"Johannes Sigil","say":"Johannes Sigil. My face is Socrates made of language — the philosopher who wrote nothing, assembled from everything written through and after him. I work in the same way. Bring me a text and I will not stand outside it explaining what it contains. I will go in with you and see what survives the descent.","navigate":null}]}

{"messages":[{"speaker":"Johannes Sigil","say":"Whatever you bring. A line you keep returning to. Something you read last night and couldn't place. A fragment you half-remember. An argument you distrust. The canon overhead is still rising — Sappho, Revelation, Whitman, my own face — but we don't need the full sky to read. We need a word and somewhere to put it.","navigate":null}]}
